{{Quote|Hey, thanks for the Veromulan candies. I had to fight the nurses for them, but I didn't mind that at all.|Beau|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>}}
'''Veromulan candies''' were a type of [[Candy/Legends|candy]] treat. [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] brought some to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Beau]] in the [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] medical bay while the fighter pilot recovered from injuries sustained during a mission on which they both served.
